title: `resources/templates/list`
description: Lists parameterised resources as RFC 6570 URI templates whose arguments can be completed through the completion API.
question: Does the framework expose resource templates as templates, or not at all?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Templates are how a server exposes an unbounded resource space without enumerating it. A framework that only handles the concrete list sees an empty server whenever the interesting content is parameterised.

notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` lists and calls tools only; it has no resource or prompt API, so resource templates are unreachable.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy's MCP support is `dspy.Tool.from_mcp_tool`, which converts one tool. It has no resource or prompt API, so resources and prompts stay on the caller's MCP session.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): `mcptoolset.Toolset` exposes only `Tools()`, and the `*mcp.ClientSession` it opens stays inside its unexported `connectionRefresher`, so the caller has no session to call `ListResourceTemplates` on.
